text: [348] 77 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā 2 alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ katame cha muṭṭhasaccaṃ asampajaññaṃ indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ bhojane amattaññutaṃ kuhanaṃ lapanaṃ ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ . cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttarimanussadhammā #1 po. atithambhaṃ . 2 ma. ...dhammaṃ . alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ katame cha muṭṭhasaccaṃ asampajaññaṃ indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ bhojane amattaññutaṃ kuhanaṃ lapanaṃ ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttarimanussadhammā 1 alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātunti .
